## Summary

Typora-style inline rendering is **partially built and tested**: non-live lines already hide inline/block-prefix markers via `elided()` + a `subs` display↔source map, with the cursor/clicked line revealed. There is **no separate inline vs source mode toggle** — it is one always-live editor. **Code fences are deliberately never hidden and have no collapse/expand** (only a copy affordance); code content keeps its source. **Overflow today: prose and code wrap at the measure; only tables get internal horizontal scroll** (plus a `wide tables` center/column setting). The decided container-inviolable rule for code blocks (§9.1) is **not yet implemented** in the shape path. Tables, callouts, task lists, math/mermaid figure slots, embeds, images, comments/CriticMarkup all render; **footnotes are explicitly unrendered**; flowchart Mermaid kinds and multi-formula lines are gaps.

## How source-hide works today

- Marker classification/flags: `src/logic/markdown/mod.rs` — `Kind` enum (`:21`), `classify` (`:103`), `inline` (`:278`)/`emphasis` (`:295`), `code` single-line lexer (`:683`), `DIM`/`CODE`/`QUIET` flag pipeline; markers "stay visible but dimmed" on the live line, hidden off it (`book/src/writing.md:5`, `docs/design/markdown_renderer.md §2`).
- Hiding engine: `elided()` at `src/views/editor/layout.rs:656-712` — hides block prefixes (`- `, `1. `, `> `, `- [ ] `, indent kept) and `DIM`-flagged inline markers, while explicitly keeping links, images, comments, callouts readable, keeping checked-task text, and never touching code (`CODE`/`QUIET` excluded) or fences/tables/math/front-matter.
- Hide gate (Typora-style): `src/views/editor/layout.rs:1624-1640` — `hide = !live && !code && !math && matches!(Para|Heading|Quote|Bullet|Ordered|Task)`; heading `#` markers go with the lead, not `elided` (`layout.rs:1660-1680` area, `skip` for headings).
- Live/revealed model (no mode toggle): the cursor's line is live; clicking a line sets `revealed` (`layout.rs` `plan()` re-lays `laid.revealed` + cursor lines, ~`layout.rs:710-760`); keyboard move alone does **not** reveal — test asserts cursor-on-title still renders title without markers while the old clicked line shows source (`layout.rs:2600-2680`, test `markers_hide_until_the_line_is_clicked_or_edited` at `layout.rs:~2560`). Typing reveals the edited line.
- Cursor/selection/find/clipboard stay on source bytes: `subs` maps display↔source (`grid::shown`/`grid::source`, round-trip test `hidden_markers_still_map_both_ways` at `layout.rs:~2500`, hit-test round-trip + `selected_text()` returns `- item one` with marker at `layout.rs:~2680-2700`). Search runs on file text including markers (`book/src/search.md:8`).
- Unit coverage of exactly what hides: `hidden()` + `non_live_lines_hide_their_markers` at `src/views/editor/layout.rs:2452-2500` (`**`, `*`/`_`, `~~`, `==`, `<u>`, backticks hide; unmatched `*`, `->`, links, `[[..]]`, tags, images, comments, tables, inline `[ ]` stay).

## Overflow behavior

- **Prose (non-table): wraps at the measure.** `wrap = (kind != Kind::Table).then(|| width - lead…)` (`layout.rs:~1752-1754`); cells wrap per-cell (`layout.rs:283`), grid lines never wrap (`layout.rs:1600`).
- **Code blocks: wrap today (gap).** Only `Kind::Table` is exempt from wrapping in the shape path, so long code lines wrap like prose; I found **no horizontal-scroll/clip path for code**. Decided rule §9.1 (container-inviolable, internal scroll/clip for code blocks, `markdown_renderer.md:231-260`) is marked **follow-up, not implemented** — this is the largest overflow gap for the owner ask.
- **Tables: internal horizontal scroll + cursor follow (implemented).** `frames()` (`layout.rs:2249-2310`): `frame_w = wide.min(room)`, `overflow = (wide-room).max(0)`, per-table `dx` persisted in `table_x`, clamped; cursor reveal scrolls with 24px margin; scrollbar thumb drawn when `overflow > 0`; rows shifted by `dx + lead`. Setting `› wide tables`: **center** (spills centered, default) vs **column** (stays in column, sideways scroll) (`book/src/settings.md:39-44`); small tables never exceed window (`:44`).
- **Container:** single centered column, Normal measure **800** (`theme.rs:50`, `editor/mod.rs:180-181,489-490`, `app-ui.md:259-290`, `markdown_renderer.md §9.2` — renderer is layout-agnostic, app owns width/type/padding).
- **Figures (math/mermaid/pictures):** drawn under their line; print shrinks to page (`writing.md` PDF); canvas overflow rule resolved only in principle (§9.1: shrink/scroll/clip internally, magnifier as escape hatch) — exact per-figure mechanics stay with editor crew.
- Long-line cases (long words, URLs, tables, code): prose wraps; tables scroll; code wraps (to fix); figures pending per-figure work.

## Top gaps for Typora parity + effort hints

1. **Code-block hide-by-default + expand/edit affordance** — new UI (header chevron/hover, collapsed preview, click-to-expand mapping to fence range, `revealed` interplay so expanded block shows source). Effort: medium (layout `hide` exemption for fences must be relaxed per-block + `elided` scope change + tests mirroring `markers_hide_until…`). Files: `views/editor/layout.rs` (`elided`, hide gate `:1624-1640`, code branch `:1578-1581`), `mod.rs:683` lexer, `render.rs`/`paint.rs` header.
2. **Code-block horizontal scroll/clip** (implement decided §9.1) — mirror table `frames()`/`table_x` dx pattern for `Kind::Code/Fence` runs; keep copy button + lang header visible. Effort: small-medium. Files: `layout.rs` shape `wrap` exemption + `frames()`, `markdown_renderer.md §9.3` checklist.
3. **Link-label hiding (optional Typora step)** — currently links deliberately stay readable; hiding `](url)` off-live needs `kept()` relaxation + URL-reveal UX + `subs` test updates. Effort: medium; risk to find/search contract (markers searchable today).
4. **Mermaid kind coverage** (flowchart/`graph TD`, ER) — bridge, not renderer (`mermaid.rs` header); effort: large (new converter or renderer swap), tracked as open, not a silent fill.
5. **Footnotes end-to-end** — syntax decision → definition collection, backlink rendering, marker-hiding + PDF/export rules. Effort: large. Until then: literal (contractual).
6. **Multi-formula lines / `$$` in tables / `\(...\)`** — needs-eyes verification first (`markdown_renderer.md §4` gaps).
